lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately five semi-parallel horizontal rows. A distinct vertical column of roughly 10 spots is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, transitioning into a grid-like pattern further posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs at regular intervals, creating a matrix where blobs serve as the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally. The primary mid-lateral ridge displays a sharp luminance gradient, with the upper surface reflecting high-intensity light and the lower surface in deep shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clusters of small, high-contrast spots are visible on the leading edge of the pectoral fin and across the dorsal surface of the head.
